class.name: ResonanceListener
class.brief_description: Native audio listener node for Nexus Resonance.
class.description: Reports listener position and orientation to [ResonanceServer] each frame from this node's global transform (forward = -Z, up = Y). Attach as a child of a [Camera3D] so the listener follows the camera. Only the listener under the active viewport camera drives the server; other listeners stay inactive so they do not overwrite the active pose. When no ResonanceListener is in the scene, [ResonanceRuntime] falls back to the active camera transform. Listener updates run at process priority 100, after nodes at the default priority 0 and before [ResonancePlayer] (110) and [ResonanceRuntime] (120). The runtime flushes pending source updates, then ticks the simulator so inverse distance attenuation uses the current source pose. With the Custom scene tracer, listener sync runs in `_physics_process` instead of `_process`. On Windows, pathing is protected by an SEH safety net when the listener moves through solid geometry; you do not need to disable [member listener_valid] for those cases.

members.member: Simulates reverb at this listener and applies it once on the reverb bus to every [ResonancePlayer] that sends there ([member ResonancePlayerConfig.reverb_send]). Only the active listener applies it.
[constant REVERB_REALTIME] ray-traces the reverb (needs [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.realtime_rays] > 0); [constant REVERB_BAKED] reads baked reverb probes.

When true, the server runs path validation for pathing. When false, pathing is skipped entirely (saves CPU). Set to false when you explicitly want to disable pathing, such as a debug camera inside geometry.

constants.constant: Baked reverb probes at the listener.
